summary: Kennedy Lewis Capital Co filed an 8-K reporting its NAV per share as of March 31, 2026 ($19.97 for Class I, $19.94 for Class S, $19.97 for Class D) and providing a status update on its continuous public offering of up to $2.0 billion in shares. The filing discloses aggregate NAV of $743.7M, a portfolio fair value of $1.1B, and total consideration raised of $662.6M across both public and private offerings. No event beyond periodic reporting and offering activity is disclosed; thus it does not reflect an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation.
